long_biography.plain_text:
Ofir Levy's work at Levy Brands centres on a vertically integrated wood-products system. The group starts with log processing, turns plywood into cabinet components and completes ready-to-assemble kitchen and bathroom products. Control over manufacturing, importing and wholesale lets it coordinate materials and finished goods within one supply chain.

A more recent focus is tool-less cabinet assembly. Levy Brands has paired plywood construction with licensed click-together technology so boxes can ship flat and be assembled inside a kitchen. The format is designed to use freight space more efficiently, reduce handling damage and shorten installation work for builders. The company has promoted the system through partnerships with American cabinet retailers.

Formerly known as Hvalross, the CdM Darwin102 luxury yacht, named Atlas, was delivered in 2017. In January 2023, the yacht underwent a change in ownership, and its last known listed price was €9,700,000. The seller's representatives were Konstantin Kolpakov and Rodion Burduzhan from Arcon Yachts, while the buyer was introduced by Rico Stoll from Engel & Völkers Yachting.

Based on information obtained from the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) records, the ownership of the yacht Atlas has been transferred to Cabinet Cove, LLC. Intriguingly, this company shares its address with Plywood Source, LLC, and MexiWood Cabinetry, both of which are owned by Ofir Levy from Arizona, USA.

Mr. Levy holds the position of chairman at Levy Brands Holding, a diversified conglomerate with a wide range of interests. Within this group, MexiWood, Plywood Source LLC, and Viet Bac Plywood LLC specialize in the production and distribution of kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, and wood panels. Notably, Mr. Levy has even uploaded videos on YouTube showcasing the operations of his wood mill located in Vietnam.

Moreover, Mr. Levy is the owner of a private jet named Levy Brands, which is a Bombardier Global Express model. This jet is registered under his company N9PS LLC.
